reference-image.title: Reference-driven illustration
reference-image.use_when: One final illustration or controlled variation from zero to several references
reference-image.tradeoff: Semantic identity/style guidance is not a guarantee of geometric or pixel identity.

stages.instruction: Resolve one, two or three role-separated references into a model-specific graph. With no references, create a text-only design draft before using an edit graph. Preserve recipe, prompt ID and candidates.
acceptance: No unrequested identity or costume transfer

stages.instruction: Compare drafts to the design spec at final size. Record a chosen image and explicit defects. Do not choose on novelty alone.
Repair only reviewed regions, retain source pixels outside protected masks and export editable layers. Use the OpenRaster helper for flat RGBA layer interchange, then Krita for native work.
acceptance: Alpha/edges inspected over light and dark

stages.instruction: Package outputs and provenance; review actual target crop/UI placement.

character-2d-frames.title: 2D character portraits and frame animation
character-2d-frames.use_when: Illustrated or pixel character with authored frame sequences
character-2d-frames.tradeoff: Most control over silhouette; redraw and manual cleanup effort scale with views and frames.

stages.instruction: Approve a neutral full-body design and portrait before generating expression or motion variations. Use separate identity, pose and style slots.
acceptance: Costume topology, face and silhouette stable

stages.instruction: Generate bounded expression variations with protected hairstyle/clothing, then repair and retain layered source.
Author contact/down/passing/up and action key poses, explicit timing, fixed floor/pivot and left/right asymmetry rules. A generated video is reference material, not frame truth.
acceptance: Mirroring does not invert asymmetric equipment

stages.instruction: Render or draw individual guided frames; compare neighbouring silhouettes. Insert in-betweens only where anatomy/contact already specified. Preserve full logical canvases.
acceptance: No foot sliding or size jitter

stages.instruction: Run game_asset_media.py atlas on approved RGBA PNG frames and their manifest. Preserve durations, anchors and frame hashes; include portraits in the deliverable index.
acceptance: Round-trip atlas crops match source pixels

stages.instruction: Import into selected engine and record an actual playback capture at target scale. Inspect loop boundary, duration and pivot behavior; structural checks alone cannot accept the animation.
acceptance: Named clips play with expected timing
Sprite origin and final-scale readability accepted

character-2d-cutout.title: Layered 2D puppet and portraits
character-2d-cutout.use_when: Dialogue portraits, idle/breathing/blinking and reusable cutout character motion
character-2d-cutout.tradeoff: Efficient recurring motion, but separated layers are not a rig and hidden surfaces need painting.

Use manual layers or evaluate Qwen-Image-Layered; name semantic parts, paint occluded overlaps and export a top-to-bottom RGBA layer manifest plus native editable source.
acceptance: No holes exposed by anticipated joint motion

stages.instruction: Build an authored Godot Skeleton2D/Bone2D or chosen licensed 2D rig. Define pivots, draw-order swaps, constraints and deformation meshes.
acceptance: Stress poses do not expose cut edges
Skeleton and animation metadata preserved outside OpenRaster

stages.instruction: Author blink, breathe and talking or idle clips with stable timing. Optional frame export is a separate output branch.
Import the rig and clips to the target runtime or export reviewed sprite frames. Preserve original editable layers and rig project.

rendered-sprites.use_when: Directional sprites, rotations, props and repetitive consistent animation
rendered-sprites.tradeoff: Requires a usable scene/rig, then makes view and pivot consistency much easier.

stages.instruction: Reuse an approved scene or construct a simple model, fixed orthographic camera, light rig, floor and render contract. Begin from existing Lanternkeeper where useful.
Author or retarget animation; define per-direction camera angles and sampled frame times. Keep deterministic geometry as the motion authority.
acceptance: Contacts, direction mapping and loop timing reviewed

stages.instruction: Render transparent PNG frames with the same camera/framing/color settings; no automatic camera re-fit per frame.
acceptance: All frames have same logical canvas

stages.instruction: Use shared-palette/pixel cleanup when required; style-transfer only as an optional branch judged for temporal drift. Pack with fixed anchors and durations.
acceptance: Shared palette rather than independent quantization

stages.instruction: Test each direction and named clip in-engine; retain Blender source and export metadata.
acceptance: Actions and view indexes mapped correctly

prop-3d.use_when: A reference/base file or description should become a usable game object
prop-3d.tradeoff: Generated shape is a proposal; topology, hidden surfaces, materials and mechanics require review.

stages.instruction: Prefer editing an approved base mesh. Otherwise compare procedural modelling with TRELLIS.2/TripoSG/PartCrafter on an actually supported isolated worker. PartCrafter parts do not automatically define hinges.
acceptance: Part boundaries agree with intended mechanics

stages.instruction: Remove floaters, repair topology, establish units/origin, unwrap/bake and create a polygon/texture budget. Retopology is required where deformation or edge flow matters.
Create PBR or stylized material channels and inspect under changing light. For cel shading document what is baked and what requires engine shaders.
acceptance: No false claim that guessed maps are measured materials

stages.instruction: For an opening chest/door, add authored hinges, limits and clips; for a static prop save an explicit no-animation contract. Add appropriate collision and LODs.
acceptance: Hinge axis and sweep clearances correct
Collision is not blindly the high-poly render mesh

stages.instruction: Export GLB or chosen format, run structural validation and import into target engine. Inspect materials, pivots, scale, collisions and clips.

character-3d.title: Rigged 3D character and motion pack
character-3d.use_when: A base mesh/reference/description should produce a skinned animated character
character-3d.tradeoff: Mesh generation, rigging, retargeting and clean gameplay motion are independent tasks.

stages.instruction: Use an approved neutral-pose base or build a suitable character mesh; review hidden geometry and costume layers before rigging.
Create/review topology and UVs, an authored rig or UniRig proposal, weights, rest pose and attachments. Record bone names, axes and root.
acceptance: No missing influences or accidental detached equipment

stages.instruction: Finish textures and face expressions or blend shapes. Validate material/export constraints separately from the rig.
Use authored or licensed motions; evaluate DART only with reviewed model/body-asset terms. HY-Motion standard terms exclude UK use and is not a default. Retarget to the actual skeleton.
Correct contacts, foot sliding, root motion, loop seams, collisions and transition poses. Generate separate in-place and root-motion versions where required.
Export mesh/skin/animations, validate structure and import. Play transitions and extreme poses with the actual controller.
acceptance: Contacts and material behavior correct in runtime

tiles-materials.title: Tiles, terrain and material sets
tiles-materials.use_when: A coherent environment set rather than unrelated beautiful textures
tiles-materials.tradeoff: Seamless images alone do not define autotile adjacency or material scale.

stages.instruction: Import atlas/materials and author target-engine terrain mapping. Include source graphs and metadata.
